name: sniper_rifle
notes: One shot, four hundred metres, no falloff, and twice the damage in the top of a body: a head shot kills outright and anything else leaves a man who has to go and find a health pack. The right button is the sight and a charge at once: hold it and the view narrows to a third while the shot winds up over a second and a bit; the left button fires it, and letting the sight down without firing throws the charge away. A full charge hits half as hard again and goes through up to a metre and a quarter of wall, hollowing a channel as it goes, so a man behind thin cover is not behind cover; a tap is an ordinary shot. Five in the magazine and two and a bit seconds to fill it, which is the whole of its weakness: miss twice in a corridor and whoever you missed is on top of you.
